title: O que tem dentro do KizuBot?
concept: Blueprint X-ray of a line-art KizuBot: the drawing traces itself, a scan reveals its internals, it explodes into parts and six numbered callouts map each part to a real module (eye = detection, brain = AI, antenna = alarms, heart = humanization, arms = combat/catch, legs = cavebot) before it snaps back together and becomes the real logo.
hook: O QUE TEM DENTRO DO KIZUBOT?
claims: detecção de shinys, megas e bosses
IA que decide o que fazer (combate com IA, cavebot com prioridades — changelog 21/02/2026)
sistema de Humanização (pausas e ritmo variáveis)
combate e captura (módulos Combat e Catch)
cavebot: anda pela rota gravada (waypoints, recorder)

notes: Callouts renumbered in the order they appear (1 olho, 2 cérebro, 3 antena, 4 coração, 5 braços, 6 pernas) so the camera path and numbering agree; captions shortened for reading speed (e.g. 'humanização: pausas e ritmo variáveis' split into the tag 'coração · humanização' + line 'pausas e ritmo variáveis'; 'cavebot: anda pela rota gravada' → tag 'pernas · cavebot' + 'anda pela rota gravada'). The robot is a hand-drawn generic line-art trace evoking the mascot (single eye), followed by the real logo. Music drop lands on callout 4 (heart) with heartbeat SFX synced to the ECG line. Loop bridge returns to the hook.
